summary: Kerb at a street junction, houses 12-17 m away, resident-permit parking.

drivers.seclusion: Homes 12 m and 17 m from the kerb; open to view on all sides.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb wraps a corner and junction mouth with stop lines; no sensible place to stand a van.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, resident permits excepted; no overnight limit but a van would stand out.

flags: Signs: 2P parallel Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, resident permits excepted
sun_shade: Open to sun; tree shade on the east side.
